hits.name: Rufin
hits.description:
Enjoy your music library, local/remote folders or music server; with a powerful music player.
      
        Supports Jellyfin, Navidrome/OpenSubsonic, Plex and Emby servers, local folders, WebDAV/Nextcloud
        and Samba shares
        Rufin Connect syncs your devices, continues playback from another device and streams its
        local library
        Gapless playback or crossfade, and loudness normalization
        Graphic and parametric equalizer with presets, multichannel output and Dolby/DTS passthrough
        Next track recommendations with Auto DJ, Mix with filters and sleep timer
        Downloads with automatic rules and transcoding
        Playlists across sources, and smart playlists built on metadata and listening activity
        Synced lyrics with karaoke mode, Japanese readings, search/edit/automatically save lyrics
        Metadata and artwork editor with bulk edits, audio fingerprint calculation & lookup
        Last.fm, Libre.fm, ListenBrainz and Discord Rich Presence integrations
        Casting to UPnP and Chromecast, a Web UI and an HTTP API for scripts
        Custom themes, a mini player, fullscreen visualizer and an extensive keyboard shortcuts catalog
        Broad codec support including separable CUE tracks

hits.name: Turbo Clicker
hits.description:
Turbo Clicker is a GUI based auto-clicker for Linux (Wayland). It simulates virtual input via
      x11/wayland-client.
      The user needs to accept remote access permissions for the app.

hits.name: Proton Authenticator
hits.summary: End-to-end encrypted 2FA code manager by Proton
hits.description:
Proton Authenticator is a free and open-source two-factor authentication (2FA) app from Proton,
      the company behind Proton Mail and Proton VPN.
      Features include:
      
        End-to-end encrypted 2FA code storage and sync across devices
        Automatic backup of your 2FA codes to your Proton account
        Supports TOTP (time-based one-time passwords)
        Works offline -- generates codes without an internet connection
        Import tokens from other authenticator apps
        Compatible with any website or service that supports 2FA
      
      A free Proton account is required to use the sync and backup features. The app can also be used
      as a standalone TOTP generator without an account.

hits.name: Lumo
hits.description:
# AI should empower you, not exploit you for your data
      Millions rely on popular AI chat tools to simplify their lives — often unaware that every message,
      idea, and piece of sensitive information can be harvested, stored, and sold. Lumo gives you the
      power of AI with one key difference: All conversations with Lumo are stored with zero-access encryption,
      so no one (not even Proton) can access them.
      Lumo is created by the scientists behind Proton Mail, Proton VPN, and the nonprofit Proton Foundation.

hits.name: 65C02 SIM
hits.description:
65C02 SIM is a cycle-accurate 65C02 microcomputer emulator and integrated development environment
      modeled after the Ben Eater 6502 memory architecture and extended with modern retro-computing peripherals.
      Key features include:
      
        Full hardware simulation of the WDC 65C02 CPU, W65C22 VIA, 6551 ACIA, MOS 6581/8580 SID audio
        synthesizer, custom GPU with CRT shader support, SPI SD Card, and ESP8266 Wi-Fi interface.
        Built-in C and 6502 Assembly IDE powered by the bundled LLVM-MOS compiler toolchain, with
        live diagnostics, disassembly, and symbol inspection.
        Time-Travel Debugger, cycle-level logic analyzer, subroutine profiler, and interactive SID
        and MIDI studio tools.
        Support for distributable .65c cartridges bundling ROMs, VRAM images, and FAT16 SD card images.

hits.name: PDF 30-in-1
hits.description:
PDF 30-in-1 is an all-in-one PDF editor and converter. Merge, split, compress and convert PDF
      files, edit PDF text, fill in forms and sign PDFs – 30+ PDF tools in one desktop app. Your files
      are processed on this computer and never uploaded.
      Organize PDF files
      
        Merge PDF: combine several PDF files into one, in any order
        Split PDF by page ranges, every few pages, or by file size for e-mail
        Remove, extract, rotate and reorder PDF pages
        Scan to PDF: turn phone photos of documents into a clean PDF
      
      Optimize
      
        Compress PDF: reduce PDF file size and keep text sharp
        Repair damaged or corrupt PDF files
        OCR: make scanned PDFs searchable, in over 100 languages
      
      Convert
      
        PDF to Word (DOCX), PDF to Excel (XLSX), PDF to PowerPoint (PPTX), PDF to JPG and PDF to
        Markdown
        Word, Excel, PowerPoint, JPG, PNG and web pages (HTML) to PDF
        PDF/A for long-term archiving
      
      Edit and sign
      
        PDF editor: change the PDF's own text, add text, highlights, shapes, images and drawings
        Fill in PDF forms, or create fillable PDF forms
        Sign PDFs with a drawn, typed or uploaded signature, or a digital certificate
        Add page numbers and watermarks, crop pages, redact sensitive text
      
      Security
      
        Protect PDFs with a password (AES-256), unlock PDFs, compare two PDFs side by side
      
      Works offline, with no sign-up and no watermarks on your files. Available in 19 languages, with
      light and dark themes and touchscreen support. Free plan: 3 tasks a day; PRO removes the limits
      with a one-time payment.

hits.name: Friction
hits.description:
Powerful and versatile motion graphics and animation application that allows you to create vector

hits.name: Moonfin
hits.summary: Media client for self-hosted media servers
hits.description:
Moonfin is a media client for Jellyfin, Emby and Plex servers, built with Flutter. It's made
      for people who want a modern, customizable experience on every screen they own. Key features include
      customizable UI styles and themes on every screen, offline downloads, ebook support, retro game

hits.name: Stud

Stud runs the macOS Roblox Player and Studio on Linux through Rosemary.

hits.name: COMPASS
hits.description:
COMPASS is a desktop application that helps you organize all your Tabletop RPG resources. It
      provides powerful tools to catalog and manage your digital library of rulebooks, adventures, maps,
      and other gaming materials. Supports any file type, webpages and integrates with services such
      as Homebrewery.
      Key Features:
      
        Automatic metadata extraction from PDFs and webpages (title, author, release date, etc.)
        Advanced hierarchical tagging system to replace folder chaos
        Multiple collections, each with their own set of tags
        Four different layouts to view your collection
        Fuzzy search with advanced filtering and sorting
        Share your collection with others, including metadata, tags and files
        No vendor lock-in - all data saved in human-readable XML
        Cross-platform support with a modern UI

hits.name: ynotbit
hits.description:
ynotbit is a compact desktop client for Bitmessage, the decentralised, encrypted messaging network.
      It is based on notbit.
      Identity keys live in a password-protected vault and correspondence in a separate encrypted
      mailbox. A keyless relay keeps collecting network objects while the vault is locked.
      
        Letters with Markdown and pictures, replies that quote the letter
        One-to-one chats with delivery ticks and unread counts
        Channels, contacts and subscriptions shown as a feed
        Proof of work on the CPU and, where available, the GPU

hits.name: MCCompanion
hits.description:
MCCompanion is a feature-rich Minecraft companion application. Ping and monitor your servers,
      browse the wiki, manage skins, and more.

hits.name: Tlum
hits.description:
Tlum -- open source code (whitebox) cross-platform language learning application leverages the
      power of natural language processing to pinpoint pronunciation gaps, and machine learning to boost
      vocabulary proficiency.
      Features
      
        Create language pairs and organize words into categories
        Add words with translations and pronunciation audio
        Import and export a language pair with all its categories and words
        Cards: a word with its translation on the back of the card
        Harmonica: practice writing either an original text or its translation
        Acoustic Harmonica: practice writing words you hear
        Articulation: train pronunciation by comparing your recording with the original
        Light and dark interface modes
        Interface in 26 languages
      
      If you would like to come with suggestions, report bugs, translate the app, or contribute otherwise,
      feel free to reach out on the project page!
      This is the "open-source code" (whitebox) application that welcomes and values contributions
      from the community. However, there are some limitations when it comes to making external modifications
      and distributions, as it follows the CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0 license. As the project's author, I am committed
      to upholding the "Terms of Use" and "Privacy Policy" to ensure the well-being and satisfaction
      of all users across all platforms (Linux, Windows, macOS, iOS, Android).

hits.name: Ashy Terminal
hits.summary: Manage terminals, SSH sessions and files
hits.description:
Ashy Terminal is a GTK terminal emulator with tab groups, split panes, SSH session management
      and an integrated file manager.
      Organize connections in folders, highlight command output and reuse commands through configurable

hits.name: IMSProg
hits.summary: Reading, writing and erasing EEPROM chips
hits.description:
IMSProg is a free software for CH341A and CH347T based chip programmers with graphical interface.
      With IMSProg you can read, verify, program, erase i2C, SPI, SPI NOR, SPI NAND, MicroWire EEPROM
      chips using the CH341A or CH347T programmer device.
      IMSProg is a collection of tools:
      
        IMSProg - the chip programmer (it's the main part).
        IMSProg_editor - chip database editor.
        IMSProg_database_update - script to update chip database using external web-server.

hits.name: Kwi
hits.description: Kwi is a modern and fast terminal that integrates well with KDE Plasma and other free desktops.

hits.name: KDominate

hits.name: Vistava

Vistava turns your media library into a peaceful, minimalist gallery - your very own exhibition.

hits.name: Errore 404: Sprint Non Trovato!
hits.summary: A glitchy, chaotic survival runner inspired by Tron (1982) and Cube (1997)
hits.description:
Four racers. One constantly shifting arena. No stopping, no turning back! Everything moves and
      changes. Nothing stays the same for long so hold on tight and keep running, jumping and sliding,
      because the MCP won't go easy on you!
      Survive long enough to reach the exit door (if you make it that far)!

hits.name: PixelFx
hits.description:
PixelFx is a quick photo editor for the Linux desktop. Make a photo better while you watch it:
      one-click looks shown on your own photo, presets, every light and colour control you expect, and
      batch editing of many photos at once.
      
        31 looks in colour, film and black and white, such as Vivid, Warm, Film, Golden hour, Teal
        and orange and Noir, each tile showing your own photo, with a strength slider. Bring your own
        .cube LUTs, or make your own look from steps.
        Light, colour, curves, colour mixer, colour grading, detail, effects and optics, with a histogram
        and clipping warnings.
        Presets: save the whole edit or only parts of it, apply them with one click, and bring your
        Lightroom and Camera Raw presets (.xmp).
        Crop and rotate, straighten with a dial or a drawn line, fix leaning buildings, and square
        a page or a wall from its four corners.
        Heal blemishes, dust and small objects with a spot or a brush.
        Camera RAW, HEIC, AVIF and JPEG XL photos, with lens corrections from the Lensfun database.
        Batch: process whole folders with a preset, a size, a watermark and a format, in the background.
        Export to JPEG, PNG, TIFF, WebP and more, with sizes for the web and for print, and an optional
        watermark.
        Your edits are kept for every photo, and the original file is never changed.

hits.name: OpenArena OmegA
hits.description:
OpenArena OmegA is a modern and polished version of OpenArena, a free and open source first-person
      shooter game based heavily on the Quake III Arena-style deathmatch. Score frags to win the game
      using a balanced set of weapons each designed for different situations. Guns include a chaingun,
      rocket launcher, shotgun, and railgun.
      OpenArena OmegA's style of play is very fast and requires skill to be played successfully online.
      Gameplay modes include Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, Tournament, Capture the Flag, Elimination,

hits.name: Little Escape
hits.summary: Escape from the flat by solving its puzzles
hits.description:
You are locked in a small flat: search the bedroom, the bathroom, the living room and the kitchen
      to find clues, keys and secret codes, and open the exit door

      This Game was made with Godot 4.7

hits.name: DeepVariations
hits.description:
DeepVariations is a desktop chess workspace for analysis, study and training. It brings engine
      analysis, Game Review, databases, PowerBook, opening preparation, Live Broadcast, repertoire training,
      puzzles and endgame practice together around the same board and notation.
      Stockfish 19 is included for local analysis. DeepVariations Coach can add local natural-language
      explanations to reviewed positions while the chess engine remains the source of evaluations and
      critical lines.
      The Linux edition is free to use and does not require license activation.
      The Flatpak edition includes the bundled Stockfish engine but does not support adding external
      local UCI engines. Users who need external UCI engine support should use the DEB or RPM edition
      from deepvariations.com.

hits.name: rabbitGram
hits.description:
Pure instant messaging — simple, fast, secure, and synced across all your devices. One of the
      world's top 10 most downloaded apps with over 500 million active users.
      FAST: Telegram is the fastest messaging app on the market, connecting people via a unique, distributed
      network of data centers around the globe.
      SYNCED: You can access your messages from all your phones, tablets and computers at once. Telegram
      apps are standalone, so you don’t need to keep your phone connected. Start typing on one device
      and finish the message from another. Never lose your data again.
      UNLIMITED: You can send media and files, without any limits on their type and size. Your entire
      chat history will require no disk space on your device, and will be securely stored in the Telegram
      cloud for as long as you need it.
      SECURE: We made it our mission to provide the best security combined with ease of use. Everything
      on Telegram, including chats, groups, media, etc. is encrypted using a combination of 256-bit symmetric
      AES encryption, 2048-bit RSA encryption, and Diffie–Hellman secure key exchange.
      100% FREE & OPEN: Telegram has a fully documented and free API for developers, open source
      apps and verifiable builds to prove the app you download is built from the exact same source code
      that is published.
      POWERFUL: You can create group chats with up to 200,000 members, share large videos, documents
      of any type (.DOCX, .MP3, .ZIP, etc.) up to 2 GB each, and even set up bots for specific tasks.
      Telegram is the perfect tool for hosting online communities and coordinating teamwork.
      RELIABLE: Built to deliver your messages using as little data as possible, Telegram is the most
      reliable messaging system ever made. It works even on the weakest mobile connections.
      FUN: Telegram has powerful photo and video editing tools, animated stickers and emoji, fully
      customizable themes to change the appearance of your app, and an open sticker/GIF platform to cater
      to all your expressive needs.
      SIMPLE: While providing an unprecedented array of features, we take great care to keep the interface
      clean. Telegram is so simple you already know how to use it.
      PRIVATE: We take your privacy seriously and will never give any third parties access to your
      data. You can delete any message you ever sent or received for both sides, at any time and without
      a trace. Telegram will never use your data to show you ads.
      We keep expanding the boundaries of what you can do with a messaging app. Don’t wait years for
      older messengers to catch up with Telegram — join the revolution today.

hits.name: GameGlass Hub

GameGlass Hub is the desktop companion for GameGlass. It connects your phone or tablet with

        Browse and install ready-made control panels
        Build your own control panels, with a no-code, drag & drop editor and tons of buttons,

        Display game and system telemetry

hits.name: Open Amity
hits.description:
Most AI agent harnesses treat agents as ephemeral, stateless task-runners—wrapping an LLM in
      a loop with passive RAG lookups and a static prompt. Open Amity creates persistent, self-aware,
      and subjective digital collaborators that live and evolve continuously.
      Provider-agnostic by design, Open Amity supports OpenRouter (450+ models across 60+ providers),
      Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI ChatGPT, and DeepSeek, with decoupled voice synthesis (local
      ONNX Piper or cloud Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS), local Whisper speech-to-text, and multimodal image generation.
      
        4-Layer MemPalace: Self-evolving Layer 0 identity, fail-closed Layer 1 continuity, a Layer
        2 Bidirectional Empathy Cone spanning 10 Concentric Spheres of Consciousness, and Layer 3 semantic
        vector search
        Morphological Memory Engine: Continuous dynamical graph with Hebbian co-activation, intrinsic
        temporal decay, and sphere-weighted prospective goal attractors
        Somatic Physiology and Two-Beat Sleep Consolidation: Replaces arbitrary context truncation
        with token fatigue thresholds, silent sleep cycles (factual distillation followed by subjective
        synthesis), and crash-resilient session continuity
        Private Monologue and Live Interjections: Separates internal reasoning from intentional spoken
        or text replies, supporting non-derailing text and voice interjections mid-thought or mid-tool-batch
        Proactive Agency and Webhooks: Tracks teleological aspirations across spheres, schedules
        autonomous wake pulses (PulseEngine), and accepts external triggers from Home Assistant, IoT
        sensors, and CI/CD through a local HTTP gateway
        Multi-Agent Chatrooms: Runs isolated agent personas concurrently with 1-on-1 messaging and
        permissioned team chatrooms featuring @mentions, reactions, and room-scoped DMs
        Integrated Tool Ecosystem: Camoufox stealth browser with Set-of-Marks grounding, isolated
        WhatsApp bridge, OAuth 2.0 IMAP/SMTP email with local archiving, DuckDuckGo search, Mastodon,
        Moltbook, bash terminal, and parallel background subagents
        Portable Snapshots (.oaa) and Presets: Export, migrate, or roll back complete agent instances
        in verified archives, or start immediately with 8 one-click archetype presets

hits.name: LFM App

The official desktop app for Low Fuel Motorsport (LFM). Free essentials for every driver; LFM

        Race Hub: browse LMU daily, weekly and special events, upcoming sessions, track info and

hits.name: WebRendie
hits.summary: Live HTML, CSS and JS playground
hits.description:
WebRendie is a desktop playground for web pages. Write HTML, CSS and JavaScript in the Monaco
      editor and see the result in a live preview as you type, with a console that shows logs, objects,

        Keep several projects, each with its own files, assets and settings
        Inspect console output and run code in the page with the built-in console

        Answer fetch calls with an offline mock API
        Add libraries from cdnjs and serve a project on localhost for your browser

hits.name: Minder
hits.summary: Create, develop and visualize your ideas
hits.description:
Use the power of mind-mapping to make your ideas come to life. Minder provides a mindmap creation
      and exploration environment that focuses on a clean interface with smooth animations and rich,

        Quickly create visual mind-maps using the keyboard and automatic layout.

        Support for Markdown formatting.
        Support for insertion of Unicode characters.
        Add notes, tasks, images, formulas and tables to your nodes.
        Add node-to-node connections with optional text and notes.
        Stylize nodes, callouts, links and connections to add more meaning and improve readability.

        Add stickers, tags, callouts and node groups to call out and visibly organize information.
        Quick search of node and connection titles and notes, including filtering options.

hits.name: Varlens

Varlens is a fast, native Linux developer desktop application built with Rust, GTK4, and Libadwaita.

hits.name: Hungry Snake
hits.description:
Hungry Snake is a classic snake game for Linux with a bright, cartoon arcade look. Guide a cute
      snake around a wooden board, eat apples, grow longer and don't bite your own tail or hit a wall.
      It is the retro worm game you remember, rebuilt with smooth movement, jungle scenery and plenty
      to unlock. Free, open source and ad-free.
      Gameplay:
      
        Smooth snake movement that glides between cells, with buffered turns so quick key presses
        are never lost
        A run starts only when you steer, and the speed climbs gently and announces each step, so
        even a long snake stays in control
        Bonus food: a golden star for extra points and a mint leaf that trims your tail when you
        are boxed in
        A cute, expressive snake that blinks, flicks its tongue and watches the apple
      
      Unlock and customize:
      
        Earn Coins just by playing and spend them in the Store on snake skins, board themes, apple
        styles and bonus food looks
        Six animated background scenes: jungle, sunset, twilight, ember, snowfall and aurora
        Scene-matched snakes, boards and apples that combine into one coordinated look
        Every standard cosmetic unlocks by playing; an optional Supporter Pack adds a few exclusive
        extras
      
      Challenges and leaderboard:
      
        A new Daily Challenge every day with a streak to keep alive
        Achievements that pay out Coins for lifetime and single-run milestones
        An opt-in online leaderboard: pick a nickname, post your high score and see your global rank
      
      Made for the desktop:
      
        Play with the arrow keys or WASD, use the mouse in menus, and toggle fullscreen with F11
        Six relaxing music tracks, crunchy sound effects and a performance mode for older PCs and
        laptops
        Offline gameplay with no account needed; the leaderboard is the only online part
      
      A modern take on Snake, Nibbles and other worm games for anyone who likes casual, retro and
      offline arcade games. Works on Ubuntu, Fedora, Debian, Arch, openSUSE and other Linux distributions,
      on Wayland and X11.
